layers.5: semantic validation: success, rejection, signature, proof and recovery cases, from the genesis evidence (foga genesis run; pass it with --genesis)
layers.D: Loop D: an unscripted run judged by its records — every operation under an allowed decision, refusals that broadcast nothing, the budget books, the operator key's transactions, the demander's cases, recovery, the entrances (foga demo --loop-d; pass the evidence with --loop-d)
